notes:
Chapter 12: programs for the 8-bit CPU (8 levels)

The computer of chapter 11 is given, wired, with an empty program
memory; the player only programs. The first two levels are machine
code by hand, 'The assembler' then unlocks assembler for every later
ACC8 program. Output, counting, a sum, multiplying by adding,
Fibonacci until the carry, division with remainder and subroutines.
Every model program runs on the CPU8 model solution itself, and the
expected outputs come from the emulator.
